guidance: No script owns this violation kind - triage: either identify the right domain and say so, or escalate to human with a render and a one-paragraph explanation.

violations.msg: ROFF2=47k was sized from TI Equation 9 (VCC charging COFF through ROFF2 alone), which is only valid when ROFF1>>ROFF2, but ROFF1=10k here, so with the string shunted the COFF node is a divider that asymptotes to 0.978 V at VCC 5.0 V and the shunt FET's typical 380 mOhm - below the 1.00 V VOFT threshold - and the OFF-timer therefore never trips, stretching every shunted cycle to tOFF(max) 230 us instead of the 5.15 us Equation-8 target and producing exactly the Figure-43 loss of constant inductor ripple and shunt-dimming linearity that this network was added to prevent.

/NTC_LED runs from J5 pin 10 straight onto U401 pins 4, 7 and 11 with no series limiting resistor and no clamp, but the LM339LV inputs are abs-max 6 V with no ESD clamp to V+ and share the same 10-way harness as four LED anodes that sit at up to 6.8 V normally and reach the SMF15A 16.7-24.4 V clamp region whenever a string is open, so one harness short or crimp error destroys the board's only over-temperature protection - the very fault class the window detector exists to catch.

/DRV_EN0..3 carry no pull-down and their only driver U201 is high-Z in the power-off state by design (SN74LVC1G08 partial-power-down rating), so during the window on every power-up where the carrier's 48->12->3.3 chain has +12V up but +3V3 not yet - and permanently on a 12 V-only bench bring-up - the four TPS92515HV PWM/enable pins are undriven and the pin's own -20 uA UVLO hysteresis current latches all four drivers on once any noise crosses the 1.0 V threshold, giving a full-current LED flash and defeating ICD s8.2's binding requirement that every output stage be gated by ENABLE.

The comparator positive feedback is returned to the sensor nodes (R409+R411 = 112k onto /NTC_LED, R412 = 56k onto /thermal/NTC_BRD) instead of the reference-ladder taps the sizing arithmetic assumed, so the idle-high /FAULT node pulls both dividers up and shifts the DC trip points (board-hot 110.8 -> 117.0 C, emitter-hot 89.7 -> 92.5 C), biases the /ADC0 and /ADC1 telemetry the carrier reads cold by 2-7 K, and leaves the emitter-open channel with net NEGATIVE feedback (trip needs Rntc > 106.2k, release needs Rntc < 191.0k) so it oscillates anywhere in that window.

The led_if sheet contains no text objects at all, so the ICD s9 bench-hazard warning that sheets.md s1.5 assigns to TP501/TP502 has no source for the P6/P7 silk op, leaving two bare-copper pads tied to a GND that floats at PoE potential without the warning ICD s9 requires on any daughter test point.

scope: fix ONLY these violations; do not touch unrelated nets/regions; re-run the failed gate when done
